what: Section title letters rise 30px and open from a frame clipped at the bottom (clip-path inset bottom 100% → -20%, .8s, .09s per letter · .045s above 6 letters) and fade from the tinted color (green) to ink in .35s. The small English title lights up letter by letter after .15s and the description floats up 10px after .2s. It restarts from the beginning each time it reaches 95% of the screen, and plays in reverse when scrolling back up
ease: COMMON.customEase (shoots up fast, settles slowly) · power1.in (color) · power2.out (description)

options.ease: Rising curve, default 0.16,1,0.3,1 — a curve name registered on the site (sbCustom) also works
options.each-long: Gap between letters (s) when over 6 characters, default .045
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top 95% — Brand feature section top 65%
options.[data-fx-part=sub]: (If any) small English title (split by letter)
